articles.title: ZDI-26-757: (0Day) Telegram rlottie Numeric Truncation Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
articles.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Telegram. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.0. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-111105.

articles.title: ZDI-26-778: Adobe Photoshop DCM Pixel Data Parsing Integer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
articles.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Adobe Photoshop. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.8. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-95636.

articles.title: ZDI-26-776: QNAP TS-453E syslog log_message Format String Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
articles.summary: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of QNAP TS-453E devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.5. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2018-10388, CVE-2018-10389.

articles.title: ZDI-26-775: GStreamer rtpL16depay Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
articles.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of GStreamer. Interaction with this library is required to exploit this vulnerability but attack vectors may vary depending on the implementation. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 9.8. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-111183.

articles.title: ZDI-26-772: Fortinet FortiSandbox Admin Profile Improper Handling of Exceptional Conditions Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
articles.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Fortinet FortiSandbox. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 4.9. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-106170.

articles.title: ZDI-26-771: Fortinet FortiSandbox login_user_profile Hard-Coded Credentials Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
articles.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Fortinet FortiSandbox. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.3. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-107656.

articles.title: ZDI-26-770: SonicWall Secure Mobile Access unzip Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
articles.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of SonicWall Secure Mobile Access. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.2. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-102257.

User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.8. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-93325.

articles.title: GHSA: Microsoft.OpenApi.YamlReader vulnerable to denial of service via YAML alias expansion
articles.summary:
### Impact

A small YAML OpenAPI document containing nested anchors and aliases can cause uncontrolled resource consumption in Microsoft.OpenApi.YamlReader and Microsoft.OpenApi.Readers. The issue affects OpenAPI document parsing through the public YAML reader APIs and can cause the parsing process to allocate excessive memory and terminate through out-of-memory conditions.

articles.title: Cisco patches new Secure Email Gateway zero-day exploited in attacks
articles.summary: Cisco has patched another actively exploited zero-day flaw in its Secure Email Gateway (SEG) that lets remote unauthenticated attackers execute commands with root privileges. [...]

articles.title: CVE-2026-102061 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary:
A Stack-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability in the phone-home daemon (phcd) of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an adjacent unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code as root via a crafted DHCP SZTP bootstrap message.

This issue only affects platforms that support Secure-ZTP.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102060 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: A NULL Pointer Dereference vulnerability in the rpd process of Juniper Networks Junos OS on MX Series and Junos OS Evolved on ACX Series allows an unauthenticated adjacent attacker to cause a denial of service via an IGMPv3 membership report received on a directly connected network.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102059 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: An Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability in the phone-home daemon (phcd) of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved on EX Series, SRX Series, and QFX Series allows an adjacent unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges via a rogue DHCP server.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102058 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: A Reachable Assertion vulnerability in the bfdd daemon of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved platforms allows an unauthenticated adjacent attacker to cause a denial of service by restarting the daemon via crafted BFD session traffic.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102057 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: A Stack-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability in the jdhcpd process of Juniper Networks Junos OS allows an unauthenticated adjacent attacker to cause a denial of service via a DHCP client response. The issue affects DHCP client operation and can interrupt related DHCP, relay, and zero-touch-provisioning services.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102056 — CVSS 7.1
articles.summary: An Out-of-bounds Read vulnerability in the cfmd process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an unauthenticated adjacent-network attacker to crash the daemon and disclose limited process memory via a specific CFM Message sent to a configured interface.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102055 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: A Stack-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability in the cfmd process of Juniper Networks Junos OS on MX Series and Junos OS Evolved on PTX Series platforms allows an unauthenticated adjacent-network attacker to execute arbitrary code as root or cause denial of service via a specific CFM Message sent to a configured down-MEP with enhanced CFM mode enabled.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102054 — CVSS 4.3
articles.summary: An Improper Handling of Length Parameter Inconsistency vulnerability in L2ALM of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an unauthenticated, adjacent attacker to obtain stale PFE packet memory via VXLAN overlay-ping traffic sent to a local VTEP.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102053 — CVSS 5.3
articles.summary: An Improper Release of Memory Before Removing Last Reference vulnerability in the l2ald process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved on QFX5K-family platforms allows a configured EVPN peer to cause a denial of service through memory exhaustion via EVPN-VXLAN active-active multihoming route processing.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102052 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: A Stack-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability in the jdhcpd process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved platforms allows an adjacent unauthenticated attacker to cause denial of service or execute arbitrary code with root privileges via a malformed DHCPv4 server response when the DHCPv4 local-client feature is used.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102051 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: An Improper Release of Memory Before Removing Last Reference vulnerability in the l2cpd process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved platforms allows an adjacent unauthenticated attacker to cause l2cpd memory exhaustion and Layer 2 control-plane disruption via LLDP traffic when fast receive processing is enabled.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102050 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: A Stack-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability in the l2cpd daemon of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an unauthenticated adjacent attacker to cause a denial of service in Layer 2 control-plane processing via LLDP packets received on an interface configured for LLDP. Repeated triggering may disrupt LLDP and other Layer 2 control protocols across the device.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102049 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: A Stack-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability in the l2cpd process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an adjacent unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code with root privileges via LLDP traffic received on an interface with Unified Access Policy enabled.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102048 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary:
An Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in the l2cpd process of Juniper Networks Junos OS allows an adjacent unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial of service and l2cpd restart via FNP-enabled Layer 2 interfaces. The issue is triggered when the FNP feature is enabled on a VPLS routing instance with VLAN-VPLS encapsulation enabled.

This issue affects all platforms

articles.title: CVE-2026-102047 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: An Improper Validation of Consistency within Input vulnerability in the l2cpd process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an adjacent unauthenticated Layer 2 attacker to cause a denial of service in associated Layer 2 control protocols via a crafted MVRP Ethernet frame sent to an MVRP-enabled interface.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102046 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: A Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop') vulnerability in netsctp.ko of Juniper Networks Junos OS on MX Series allows an unauthenticated network attacker to cause a denial of service via crafted SCTP network traffic.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102045 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: An Out-of-bounds Write Out-of-bounds Write vulnerability in lacpd of Juniper Networks Junos OS Evolved allows a Layer-2-adjacent attacker to cause a denial of service via a crafted frame received on an LACP-enabled aggregated-Ethernet member port.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102044 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: A Reachable Assertion vulnerability in the rpd process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows a configured BGP-LS peer to cause a denial of service via a BGP-LS update.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102043 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: A Numeric Truncation Error vulnerability in the rpd process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an adjacent attacker to crash the routing process via MPLS-TE fast-reroute signaling.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102042 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: A Reachable Assertion vulnerability in the rpd process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an adjacent attacker to crash the routing process via RSVP-TE associated-bidirectional LSP signaling.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102041 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: A Reachable Assertion vulnerability in the rpd routing daemon of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an adjacent unauthenticated network attacker to cause a denial of service via malformed RSVP signaling when RSVP is enabled.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102040 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: A NULL Pointer Dereference vulnerability in the rpd routing daemon of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an adjacent unauthenticated attacker to crash the routing daemon and cause a denial of service via an RSVP Path message.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102039 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: A NULL Pointer Dereference vulnerability in the rpd process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an adjacent attacker to cause a denial of service via a malformed RSVP Path message received on an EVPL LMP control channel.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102037 — CVSS 8.1
articles.summary: An XML Injection vulnerability in the Unified Threat Management daemon (utmd) of Juniper Networks Junos OS on SRX Series devices allows an unauthenticated network attacker to commit arbitrary device configuration with root privileges via a malicious response from a configured custom URL-feed server.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102036 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: An Integer Overflow or Wraparound vulnerability in the l2ald process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows a configured EVPN BGP peer to cause a denial of service via EVPN Type-2 MAC/IP routes.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102035 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: A Reachable Assertion vulnerability in the l2ald process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an adjacent attacker to cause a denial of service via an ICCP peer message when MC-LAG IRB MAC synchronization is enabled.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102034 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: A Reachable Assertion vulnerability in the l2ald daemon of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an attacker with access to a configured ICCP peer to cause a denial of service via a malformed MC-LAG message.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102033 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: An Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input vulnerability in l2ald of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an adjacent attacker to cause a denial of service via an ICCP MC-LAG message.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102032 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: A Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime vulnerability in the l2ald process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an unauthenticated adjacent attacker to cause a denial of service via crafted packets when the static MAC-IP feature is in use.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102031 — CVSS 9.8
articles.summary: An OS Command Injection vulnerability in TACACS of Juniper Networks Junos OS Evolved allows a low-privileged TACACS+-authenticated user to execute commands with root privileges when periodic TACACS+ authorization-refresh is enabled.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102030 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: An Incomplete Cleanup vulnerability in the rpd process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows a configured MVPN neighbor to cause a denial of service via a BGP MVPN update when an inter‑region segmented VRF with 'protocols mvpn inter-region-template' is configured.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102029 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: A NULL Pointer Dereference vulnerability in the routing protocol daemon (rpd) of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an unauthenticated configured MSDP peer or adjacent PIM sender to cause a denial of service via an MSDP or PIM policy that uses AS-path expansion.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102028 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: A NULL Pointer Dereference vulnerability in the routing protocol daemon (rpd) of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows a remote BGP peer to cause a denial of service when multiple UPDATEs occur over a single TCP session with 'bgp family l2vpn auto-discovery-only' configured.

articles.title: CVE-2026-102027 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: An Incorrect Calculation of Buffer Size vulnerability in the routing protocol daemon (rpd) of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows a configured eBGP neighbor to cause an rpd crash via BGP labeled-unicast UPDATEs when the affected multipath features are enabled.
